root=Path.cwd();task=root/'.local/tool-tasks/ranked-mandatory-bound-20261006'
def read(name):return json.loads((task/name).read_text())
def source(p):
 return {'source':p.read_text(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def messages(record):
 return [json.loads(line)['Message'] for p in Path(record['path']).parent.joinpath('logs').rglob('process.jsonl') for line in p.read_text().splitlines()]
def profile(record):
 result={}
 for msg in messages(record):
  if 'SEARCH_PARALLEL_WORK kind=MandatoryEndTurn' not in msg:continue
  d=dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)=(\S+)',msg));t=result.setdefault(d['kind'],{'count':0,'elapsedSumMs':0,'maximumConcurrency':0})
  t['count']+=int(d['count']);t['elapsedSumMs']+=float(d['elapsed_sum_ms']);t['maximumConcurrency']=max(t['maximumConcurrency'],int(d.get('max_concurrency',0)))
 return result
pure=read('pure-screen-summary.json');diagnostics=read('cost-diagnostic-summary.json')
assert len(pure)==8 and len(diagnostics)==2
summary=[]
work_keys=['totalExpanded','totalTransitions','totalChoiceBranches','totalWorkerAllocatedBytes','totalGcPauseMilliseconds']
for scene in dict.fromkeys(x['scene'] for x in pure):
 runs=[x for x in pure if x['scene']==scene];a=[x for x in runs if x['label'].startswith('A')];c=[x for x in runs if x['label'].startswith('C')]
 assert all(x['status']=='Completed' for x in runs)
 assert all(x['comparisonQuality']==runs[0]['comparisonQuality'] for x in runs)
 assert len({x['rootStampSha256'] for x in runs})==1
 assert all(x['budget']==runs[0]['budget'] and x['policy']==runs[0]['policy'] for x in runs)
 for key in work_keys[:3]:assert c[0]['solverMetrics'][key]==c[1]['solverMetrics'][key]
 counts=[{k:int(v) for k,v in re.findall(r'(\w+)=(\d+)',m)} for m in c[0]['mandatoryDiagnostics']]
 count_totals={k:sum(x.get(k,0) for x in counts) for k in ['probes','pruned','rejected','saved','waves','parallel_nodes']}
 assert c[0]['mandatoryDiagnostics']==c[1]['mandatoryDiagnostics']
 d=next(x for x in diagnostics if x['scene']==scene)
 assert d['status']=='Completed' and d['comparisonQuality']==c[0]['comparisonQuality']
 assert d['rootStampSha256']==c[0]['rootStampSha256'] and d['budget']==c[0]['budget'] and d['policy']==c[0]['policy']
 assert all(d['solverMetrics'][k]==c[0]['solverMetrics'][k] for k in work_keys[:3])
 assert d['mandatoryDiagnostics']==c[0]['mandatoryDiagnostics']
 cost={}
 for msg in messages(d):
  if 'RANKED_MANDATORY_COST ' in msg:
   for k,v in re.findall(r'(\w+)=([\d.]+)',msg):cost[k]=cost.get(k,0)+float(v)
 means=[statistics.mean(x['wallSeconds'] for x in arr) for arr in [a,c]]
 summary.append({'scene':scene,'times':{x['label']:x['wallSeconds'] for x in runs},'baselineMeanSeconds':means[0],'candidateMeanSeconds':means[1],'speedup':means[0]/means[1],
 'peakChangePercent':100*(max(x['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for x in c)/max(x['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for x in a)-1),
 'quality':runs[0]['comparisonQuality'],'all14QualityFieldsIdentical':True,'sameRootPolicyBudget':True,
 'actualCountersPerCandidate':count_totals,'productionParallelWorkProfileC1':profile(c[0]),
 'work':{k:{'baseline':a[0]['solverMetrics'][k],'candidate':c[0]['solverMetrics'][k]} for k in work_keys},
 'gcPauseMilliseconds':{x['label']:x['solverMetrics']['totalGcPauseMilliseconds'] for x in runs},
 'diagnosticCost':cost,'diagnosticRootPolicyBudgetQualityCountersAndLogicalWorkSameAsPure':True})

builds={}
for p in task.glob('build-*.log'):

 'elapsed':(re.findall(r'Time Elapsed (\S+)',text) or [None])[-1],
 'warnings':(re.findall(r'(\d+) Warning\(s\)',text) or [None])[-1],
 'errors':(re.findall(r'(\d+) Error\(s\)',text) or [None])[-1]}
native={}
